mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (current value below 4.5%) compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is below 4.5% (as of t-1mo), the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 30% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL above 300.0) signals potential monetary tightening and reduced equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL is above 300.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 30% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% and the CPI index exceeds 300.0, it signals a high-inflation, high-rate environment that compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 300.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 30% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE below 4.0%) signals a strong labor market and robust economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 4.0%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 30% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST above 1300.0) signal strong consumer demand and economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST is above 1300.0, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 30% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO above 102.0) signals robust supply chain and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is above 102.0, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 30% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A high residential sales (RSAFS) value compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS is above 700000.0 (as of t-1mo), the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 30% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS above 158000 and UNRATE below 4.0%) signals robust economic growth and consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 158000 AND UNRATE < 4.0, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 30% of instances.
